metric_definitions.mae: Mean absolute error per trading day, in currency units.
metric_definitions.rmse: Root mean squared error per trading day; penalises large misses more.
metric_definitions.wmape: Sum of absolute errors divided by sum of actual values over the evaluated days (undefined, shown as null, if actuals sum to zero).
metric_definitions.total_ape_mean: Average absolute % error of the TOTAL over each forecast window.
metric_definitions.evaluated_days: Trading days only (observed sales and isolated zero-sales days); closed weekdays and data gaps are excluded.

7.selection_rule: Lowest validation WMAPE across rolling origins; the test window was not used.

interval.method: Empirical quantiles of out-of-sample relative errors from rolling-origin forecasts, by horizon bucket (assumes future errors resemble past ones).

30.selection_rule: Lowest validation WMAPE across rolling origins; the test window was not used.

90.selection_rule: Lowest validation WMAPE across rolling origins; the test window was not used.
90.reason: The selected model's WMAPE on the final test window was 46%, above the 40% limit, so this horizon is not offered.

explainability.note: Importance shows what the model relies on to predict. It is not evidence of what causes sales.

limitations: No holiday or promotion calendar is used, so public holidays and seasonal closures are not anticipated.
Forecasts assume the closed-weekday pattern seen in the data continues.
Intervals are empirical error bands, not model-based probability statements.
